title: THE FLOW DRAWS AND TICKS ARE EXCEPTION SAFE
why: The cloud review of 2026-10-15 (finding 28): each draw of the raid flow and the party (the fires, the air strike, the events, the strongholds, the golden enemy, the power-up chips and the combo rings) saved the canvas state and switched blend mode, and a single bad number (a non finite radius in a gradient) left the saved state open and the additive blend on for every piece drawn after it, in every later frame. Each is now run under a guard that counts its saves and closes whatever it left open, and puts the blend mode, the alpha and the dash back. The flow ticks each have a try of their own, so one that throws stops itself for that frame and not the ticks after it.
now: The flow and party HUD draws and ticks are now exception safe, one throw cannot leave the canvas in a bad state.
